clips.title: The story
paras: In Nightmares is a Horde quest that tasks an adventurer with carrying a disturbing relic, the Nightmare Shard, to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Originally recovered as a glowing fragment from the Wailing Caverns, the shard reveals a deeply unsettling corruption seeping into the Emerald Dream.

After examining the strange crystal retrieved from the depths of the Wailing Caverns, Falla Sagewind recognizes that it is made from the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. Yet the vision dwelling inside is dark and chaotic, bearing the hallmark not of peaceful slumber, but of a waking nightmare. Reluctant to speak openly about such alarming omens, she entrusts the shard to you with instructions to seek out Thunder Bluff's most venerated elder druid, Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.
I do not wish to alarm you, friend, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.
Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.

clips.title: Progress
paras: May I help you with something?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...
Friend, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.
Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...
Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
